blockers.goal: vvecea2_collapse_bridge : forall v':VVecEA2, exists Phi:VeeExistsForall sig F 2, forall env, env 0 < env 1 -> (veeSat N env Phi <-> v'.holds N atomMap (env 0)(env 1)), under (N, atomMap, h_surj, HasAttainedINF, HasAttainedSUP)
blockers.root_cause: The per-clause reverse translation (VecEA2 clause -> ExistsForallFormula with efSat <-> vea.holds) is the Def 4.1 atom-collapse. prop42_efSat_negation_general (Prop42NegationGeneral.lean:997-1004) emits v' = (negLeftClauseTL).disj (middleBracket.negFix) |>.disj (negRightClauseTL); every non-trivial clause carries an arbitrary TL formula at its endpoint (negLeftClauseTL = neg belowFormula :919, negRightClauseTL = neg aboveFormula :950, middleBracket.negFix the Lemma 5.1 INF/K+ engine), none a unaryToFormula-image of a UnaryType. A UnaryType (ExistsForallFormula.lean:57,67) expresses only conjunctions of E[Sigma] atomic literals at a point; capturing an arbitrary TL formula requires atom_eval_new on canonExpand (ESigmaExpansion.lean:122) - an E[Sigma]-definability/capture property. The signature's hypotheses do not supply it (HasAttainedINF/SUP are first-occurrence attainment, PriorINF.lean:202,254, not definability; h_surj names preds with atoms, not TL formulas with preds). No reverse TL->exists-forall or Formula->UnaryType translation exists in-tree.
blockers.what_is_needed: A /research dispatch to (a) determine the exact E[Sigma]-capture hypothesis (likely: N is a canonExpand, or a forall A, exists tau:UnaryType, forall y, unaryHolds N tau y <-> temporal_truth N atomMap y A over the relevant finite formula set), (b) verify its availability at beta's consumers (Phases 11-13), (c) re-scope Phase 10a with the hypothesis threaded, then compose the discharged per-clause translation through the landed vvecea2_collapse_of_perClause assembly lemma.
